Step 5 names the journal lock-busy retry rule (unavailable, bounded caller-side backoff under a cap) — #2345. Step 7 retains the pr_ready handoff skip rule — #2344. Step 8 (merge train, not_run for conflicting PRs, self-check, WIP cap) and step 10 (default loop: end condition, order, no waiting in place, resume after handoff — user decision in #2390) added by #2388; step 7's stop defers to step 10. Short waits, lean change reports, and outward effects as separate commands added by #2401. Entry spelling `--mode-agent` only, legacy alias removed (user decision 2026-11-10, #2286). Label rules added by #2434. Steps 8, 9, 12 and 13: lanes open their own pull requests below four non-draft ones and settle a simultaneous opening by the four lowest numbers (others become drafts), the U6 integration gate (no tip chasing), the one-line round, and the waiting-branch suffix — #2515. Steps 12 keep-going and 14 wake added, report/pr-gate/heavy-checks/claim/goal-lines/self-pick changed so a round never stops on LANE-DONE, a full open-PR count, a wait or a leader request (#2515 comment 6823975793). Step 3 four-way Issue counts and step 13 LANE-BLOCKED for expired foreign claims (cause 8, #2515 comment 6824158448). Step 13 end condition matches keep-going (audit 6824297146 N1). Worktree sessions without the project settings file run no project hook, so claim-verify is the only boundary there (#2581). Orca session-control section, identical in both mode workflows (#2516, leader decision B 6823474405). Bottleneck rules (#2612): renewal by editing the own claim comment, every earlier claim id in a handoff request, a fresh branch for an unread trailer, the open-PR limit N from decision D7 with cross-lane `pr-wait` order, pre-push checks, a slot wait is no wake reason, a lost reservation posts no verdict, no-op wake backoff and no reprint of unchanged lines, the poll interval only for unchanged state. Decided values (#2612, #1975 comment 6840449133): same-session renewal without a handoff line (D1), lane timeout takeover by=timeout under three conditions (D2), written user questions (D5), fallback wake up to 1,800 seconds (D6), open-PR limit eight (D7). No author ci: line (D4, #2612, #1975 comment 6840449133): the auditor cites the head's CI run in the verdict and the merge gate reads the head's check runs.
